args.sql:
SELECT 
    comm.commregistry AS communication_registry,
    risk.riskregistry AS communication_risk,
    comm.vpnflag AS vpn_usage,
    comm.langpattern AS language_pattern,
    comm.msgtally AS message_count,
    CASE
        WHEN nb_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' = 'High-risk' THEN 'Deceptive Pattern'
        WHEN nb_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' = 'Suspicious' THEN 'Deceptive Pattern'
        WHEN nb_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' = 'Normal' THEN 'Normal Pattern'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS communication_pattern
FROM 
    communication AS comm
JOIN 
    riskanalysis AS risk ON comm.commregistry = risk.commref
ORDER BY 
    communication_pattern DESC;
